# Moorland Inquisitor: "{2}{W}: This creature gains first strike until end of turn."
# Shape: B3-grant-kw-self ("{2}{W}: This creature gains flying until end of turn." parses) with
# KeywordAbility(FIRST_STRIKE); the template's keyword list does not include first strike.
first_strike = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(
        CostManaColor(color='W', amount=QConst(value=1)),
        CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=2)),
    )),
    effect=A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
        'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.FIRST_STRIKE),
        'duration': DurationEot(),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
            filter=FAnd(children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            )),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [first_strike, *compiled]

clauses.clause: {2}{W}: This creature gains first strike until end of turn.
